items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: Well, with King Oliver I think we got... We got a pretty fair price. We were getting forty dollars a week.

ctx.x: We ought to talk a little bit about that period of the Depression. It seems that while there was certainly an economic depression, that the musicians seemed to do fairly well, that they worked and they made money from tips and from just the regular payment for jobs and so forth. When you were traveling with Oliver, that was really the beginning of the Depression. Did you experience any difficulties playing with Joe Oliver as far as the money was concerned?
Well, with King Oliver I think we got... We got a pretty fair price. We were getting forty dollars a week. Whether we worked three days or two days or five days or six
